scope: DESI DR1 LRGxELG 120-mock finite-mock calibration of frozen wake matched filter

empirical_resolution.note: With 120 mocks the empirical calibration cannot resolve a smaller tail probability.

comparison_to_frozen_40_mock_finite_cali.interpretation: The finite-mock significance is essentially unchanged when increasing the ensemble from 40 to 120 mocks.

interpretation: The frozen full-sky DESI matched filter shows a stable approximately two-sigma hint after finite-mock calibration, not a detection. The nominal Hartlap-Gaussian significance is 2.217 sigma, while empirical LOO calibrations give 1.84 sigma from |Z| and 1.96 sigma from the Sellentin-Heavens likelihood-ratio statistic.
guardrail: Do not alter bins, templates, cuts, nuisance inputs, random density, tracer ordering, or estimator settings based on this result. Survey-window-convolved forward modeling remains the principal physical-modeling limitation.
